Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect fallback rule that equated a consort’s realm (Queen of Portugal) with her nationality, deciding to treat Maria of Aragon as Portuguese. This misinterprets “nationality” and ignores clear evidence that she was Spanish by birth (an Aragonese/Spanish infanta). This methodological error led toward the wrong solution instead of accepting or further confirming the correct Spanish nationality.
